answer: Since the hollow hash is stored at intake, the fable graph groups the endorsements and the pigment audit reveals the collapse. An operator copying one text across 153 aliases hence pays for 153 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, since the hash is the same for all of them. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 3 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
